Renukaswamy Murder Case: Two Accused Seek Approver Status

Two accused in the Renukaswamy murder case have sought approver status, with a court hearing their pleas on August 10. The two men, identified as Suresh and Raju, claim to have information about the murder. The court will consider their requests on August 10.
